title: World Championship Decks 2000: card flavor text

entities.name: Barrin
entities.description: A master wizard and Tolarian who comments on progress reports and clockwork devices.

entities.name: Jhoira
entities.description: An artificer who wonders what boredom feels like.

entities.name: Ertai
entities.description: A wizard adept.

entities.name: Rana
entities.description: The Suq'Ata market fool.

entities.name: Barb Tail
entities.description: A viashino heretic who wants to break the chains that bind her people to long-dead masters.

entities.name: Whip Tongue
entities.description: A viashino technician who struggles to keep goblins in their areas.

entities.name: Daudi
entities.description: A Femeref tutor who reveals rather than teaches.

entities.name: Volrath
entities.description: A figure who no longer misses sunlight.

entities.name: Serra
entities.description: A figure who urges belief in the ideal rather than the idol.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: A planeswalker artificer whose children, the metathran, were made by an integrated system of machines.

entities.name: Mishra
entities.description: Urza's brother and rival, whose campaign strategy was that if he couldn't have Argoth, no one could.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: A being who calms wild flashing by squeezing a powerstone.

entities.name: Ashnod
entities.description: A figure who left her mark in the bloodlines of those she tortured.

entities.name: Ramos
entities.description: A figure who bled, and there was fire.

entities.name: Yawgmoth
entities.description: A being who craves one commodity only.

entities.name: Afari
entities.description: Author of the Tales.

entities.name: Titania
entities.description: A forest figure who rewards those who honor the forest.

entities.name: Oracle en-Vec
entities.description: An oracle who prophesies the fishers' nets will be filled with dust.

entities.name: Brothers' War
entities.description: The war that scarred the land.

entities.name: Argoth
entities.description: A place Mishra wished to deny to others.

events.summary: Karn grasps and squeezes a powerstone, ending its wild flashing.
events.quote: Karn said nothing—he just grasped the powerstone and squeezed tightly. The wild flashing ceased.
